_comment: mcp-core.json — Tier 1: always-on servers, $0/mo, all profiles include these.

lmcp._comment: LMCP — 111 tools for macOS native apps (Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, OneDrive, Notes, Reminders, iMessage, Safari, Office). Proprietary license, currently free. Lock in install now.

git._comment: Repo operations: status, diff, commit, log, branch. MIT.

sqlite._comment: Persistent CRM database. Agents query via natural SQL. MIT.

memory._comment: Knowledge graph for cross-session entity relationships. Complements SQLite — SQLite stores facts, Memory MCP stores relationships and observations. Official Anthropic reference server, MIT.
